Yatra for Business

Up to INR 2,500 OFF*

On Domestic Flights

RBL BANK Credit Card offer

Apply the promo code YATRARBL on your RBL BANK Credit Card and avail lucrative flat-rate discount on flights (domestic and international) and hotels (domestic) booking.



ProductMin. Transaction ValueDiscount
Domestic Flights 3,000 Up to Rs.2,500 OFF
International Flights 15,000 Up to Rs.7,500 OFF
Domestic Hotel 3,000 Up to Rs.7,500 OFF

Domestic flight booking offer:


    • Flat INR 650 off for one passenger for one-way trip
    • Flat INR 900 off for one passenger for a round trip.
    • Flat INR 1,250 off for two passengers for a one-way trip.
    • Flat INR 1,800 off for two passengers for a round trip.
    • Flat INR 1,800 off for three and more passengers for a one-way trip.
    • Flat INR 2,500 off for three and more passengers for a round trip.

International flight booking offer:


  • Flat 8% off (up to INR 7,500) on international flights.

Hotel booking offer:


  • Flat 12% off (up to INR 7,500) on domestic hotels.
  • Offer days and validity: Everyday, from 1 September to 30 September 2026.
  • Promo code: YATRARBL
  • Applicable on: RBL BANK Credit Card
  • Minimum transaction value: INR 3,000 for domestic hotels; INR 15,000 for international flights; INR 3,000 for domestic flights.

How to avail the offer:


    • The offer is valid on payment made with RBL BANK Credit Cards only.
    • Enter the promo code ‘YATRARBL’.
    • The offer can be availed everyday, between 1 September and 30 September 2026.
    • The offer can be availed on the Yatra website and the Yatra app.
    • The offer can be availed once per card, per category, per month during the offer period.

Conditions for cancellation:


    • In the event of full or partial cancellation the offer stands void, and customer will no longer be eligible for the discount. Yatra will refund the amount after adjusting the discount and any other applicable charges and penalties.
    • In case the customer cancels the booking after availing the discount, Yatra will deduct the discount amount from the refund and cancellation charges would apply.
    • In case of a rescheduling, the customer has to bear the fare difference and any other rescheduling or cancellation charges.

Yatra terms of the offer:

  • The offer is applicable only on RBL BANK Credit Cards.
  • The offer is valid only on the eligible BINs shared by RBL BANK. If the BIN series of the card does not match with the one provided by RBL BANK to Yatra, then the cardholder will need to approach RBL BANK and Yatra shall be entitled to withhold or deny the offer to the customer.
  • In the event of technical errors, system glitches, or incorrect pricing or inventory information, Yatra reserves the right to cancel or modify bookings. To ensure customer protection, any amount received will be fully refunded to the original mode of payment (if any), in accordance with applicable laws and company policy.
  • If the cardholder does not receive the discount, he/she can claim the same within three months of the booking date. In the event the cardholder fails to do so, he/she will not be eligible for any discount.
  • Any add-on card would be treated as separate cards.
  • The offer cannot be availed on split bookings, where a customer makes multiple bookings in order to avail multiple discounts.
  • The offer is valid on international flight bookings originating from India.
  • For Hotels, Villas & Apartments, Instant discount will be calculated on the property’s basic price (pre-tax price).
  • The offer is valid on select hotels.
  • The offer not valid on “Pay at Hotel” bookings.
  • The offer is valid only on confirmed flight bookings done on the Yatra website or Yatra app.
  • The offer cannot be exchanged or clubbed with any other offer on Yatra.
  • The offer is not applicable for customers redirected from affiliate and meta channels.
  • The offer is not valid if you are a travel agent. Yatra has the right to recover the discounted amount if such a case is brought/comes to Yatra’s notice.
  • Yatra reserves the right, at any time, without prior notice and liability and without assigning any reason whatsoever, to add/alter/modify its terms and conditions or replace wholly or in part, this offer by another offer, whether similar or not, or to extend or withdraw it altogether.
  • Yatra’s decision in all matters in connection with or incidental to this offer would be final and binding.
  • You cannot exchange the offer for cash or any other value.
  • In case of full/partial cancellation, Yatra’s offer stands void and the customer will not be eligible for the discount. Yatra will refund the amount after adjusting the discount and any other applicable charges and penalties.
  • In case of a refund, the discounted amount will be deducted from the total refund due.
  • All disputes arising out of, or in connection with this offer shall be subject to exclusive jurisdiction of Court at Gurugram.
  • For any claims related to the card, you need to approach the bank. Yatra shall not entertain any such claims.
  • Yatra is the sole authority for the interpretation of these terms.
  • Yatra shall not be liable for any loss or damage arising due to force majeure event.
  • In the event of a misuse or abuse of the offer by the customer, Yatra reserves the right to deny the offer or cancel the booking.
  • In no event will the entire liability of Yatra under this offer exceed the amount of promotional discount.
  • Yatra shall not be liable for any indirect, punitive, special, incidental or consequential damages arising out of or in connection with the offer.
  • All the tickets are subject to availability at the time of booking and will be governed by the standard airline terms and conditions.
  • Products offered under this programme are subject to availability.

RBL BANK terms of the offer:

  • The offer is an instant discount and will be provided upfront at the time of purchase.
  • RBL BANK holds out no warranty or makes no representation about quality, delivery or otherwise of the services offered by the partner. Any dispute of claim regarding the services/offers must be resolved by the cardholder with the partner directly without any reference to RBL BANK.
  • RBL BANK shall not be liable in any manner whatsoever for any loss/damage/claim that may arise out of use or otherwise of any goods/services/assured gifts/gift vouchers availed by the cardholder under the said offer offered by the partner.
  • RBL BANK shall not be held liable for any delay or loss that may be caused in delivery of the services.
  • The offer is made available to customers selected at the discretion of RBL BANK.
  • The offer cannot be clubbed with any other offer.
  • The customer needs to use the promo code mentioned as a part of the communication to avail the offer. In case the code has not been used, discount/cashback cannot be credited back to the customer at a later date.
  • A customer availing the offer shall be deemed to have accepted these Terms and Conditions.
  • RBL BANK reserves the right, at any time, without prior notice and liability and without assigning any reason whatsoever, to add/alter/modify its terms and conditions or replace wholly or in part, this offer by another offer, whether similar or not, or to extend or withdraw it altogether.
  • Eligible benefits for this promotion (such as reward points/cashback) will only be posted to accounts that are active at the time of postings.
  • Benefits will not be posted on credit card accounts that are permanently delinquent or closed at the time of posting.
  • Benefits will also not be posted on retail credit card accounts that are flagged for working capital usage.
  • Purchases done using RBL BANK Credit Card via UPI mode shall not be eligible for the offer.
  • RBL BANK cardholders are not bound in any way to participate in this offer. Any participation is voluntary, and the offer is being made purely on a best effort basis.
  • Nothing herein amounts to a commitment by RBL BANK to conduct further, similar, or other offers.
  • This offer is non-cashable, non-extendable, and non-negotiable.
  • Purchases eligible for instant discount/cashback on RBL BANK Credit Card will not qualify for reward points. The same will be reversed within 120 days.
  • If a card member has more than one RBL BANK Credit/Debit Card, spends on the cards cannot be clubbed by the card member to qualify for the said offer.
  • The above offer is by way of a special offer co-funded by the Bank & Merchant for select RBL BANK Credit/Debit cardholders only and nothing contained herein shall prejudice or affect the terms and conditions of the card member agreement. The terms of the above schemes shall be in addition to and not in derogation of the terms contained in the card member agreement.
  • All disputes, if any, arising out of or in connection with or because of above offers or otherwise relating hereto shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the competent courts/tribunals in Mumbai only, irrespective of whether courts/tribunals in other areas have concurrent or similar jurisdiction.
  • Any query regarding the programme will be entertained till 60 days from the posting date. After said date the Bank will not entertain any correspondence or communication regarding this programme from the cardholder.
  • Any tax, service charge or other charges levied with regards to the promotional offer, may be borne by the cardholder/winner.

  • Yatra Online, Inc is the parent company of Yatra Online Limited (formerly known as Yatra Online Private Limited). which is based in Gurugram, India, and is India's leading Corporate Travel services provider with over 700+ Corporate customers, and one of India's leading online travel companies and operates the website Yatra.com. The company provides information, pricing, availability, and booking facility for domestic and international air travel, domestic and international hotel bookings, holiday packages, buses, trains, in city activities, inter-city, and point-to-point cabs, homestays, and cruises. As a leading platform of accommodation options, Yatra provides real-time bookings for more than 103,000 hotels in India and over 1,500,000 hotels around the world.

    Launched in August 2006, Yatra was ranked the Most Trusted E-Commerce Travel Brand in India in the Economic Times Brand Equity Survey 2016 for the second successive year, and has won the National Tourism Award for 'Best Domestic Tour Operator (Rest of India)' conferred by the Government of India for the fourth time.
